note: Every raw source used by tools/audio/build.py. All from OpenGameArt.org, licence CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). Processing per sound: see tools/audio/recipes.py (recipe id = sound id).

rifle_shot.title: Rifle shot
rifle_shot.processing: Single rifle shot: AR-15 / SKS / AK recordings, tape x1.7, tail cut, tabletop room.

rifle_burst.title: Rifle burst
rifle_burst.processing: 3-5 round burst (AK-47 short burst), tape x1.65.

mg_sustained.title: MG sustained fire
mg_sustained.processing: Long bursts (PPSh, Carl Gustav M45), tape x1.5 - heavier than the rifle, small low layer.

sniper_suppressed.title: Suppressed sniper
sniper_suppressed.processing: Silenced shots (EmoPreben) x1.25 + tiny bolt cycle (equipment clicks).

carbine_shot.title: Engineer carbine
carbine_shot.processing: Lighter carbine pop (Ruger Mk III .22 / Walther PPQ), tape x1.85.

reload.title: Reload
reload.processing: Mag out / mag in / charge (gun reload recordings), tape x1.45.

impact_flesh.title: Impact: flesh
impact_flesh.processing: Wet bullet hits (qubodup splats / meat), tape x1.6, 0.25 s.

impact_metal.title: Impact: car metal
impact_metal.processing: Cast-iron and sheet-metal pings, tape x1.7.

impact_wood.title: Impact: wood
impact_wood.processing: Wood impacts (35 wooden cracks/hits), tape x1.6.

flame_ignite.title: Ignite
flame_ignite.processing: Flare ignition + catching fire, tape x1.3.

flame_roar.title: Roar (loop)
flame_roar.processing: Pressurised gas jet x1.15 layered with fire roar x1.3; low-mid kept so it feels dangerous.

flame_stop.title: Stop
flame_stop.processing: Jet cut-off: roar tail + steam hiss puff.

corpse_fire.title: Corpse fire crackle (loop)
corpse_fire.processing: Fireplace crackle x1.4 + crackling, small and spitty.

car_explosion.title: Car explosion
car_explosion.processing: Crack + body tape x1.45, tight room, controlled low layer (-12 dB) at original pitch.

chain_explosion.title: Chain reaction
chain_explosion.processing: 4-5 car blasts cascading + debris rain; the low layer is raised to -3 dB here - deep impact reserved for chains.

fire_whoosh.title: Fire whoosh
fire_whoosh.processing: Swish + flare + gas burst - the fireball after a car blows.

debris_rain.title: Debris rain
debris_rain.processing: Tiny metal / wood / gravel bits pattering down, tape x1.8.

zombie_idle.title: Idle groans
zombie_idle.processing: Recorded zombie moans (artisticdude, darsycho, antumdeluge, EmoPreben), pitch x1.32 - squeaky but still gross.

horde_small.title: Horde: small (loop)
horde_small.processing: ~10 individual squeaky voices layered - what a street group sounds like close up.

horde_medium.title: Horde: medium (loop)
horde_medium.processing: ~40 voices - individual growls start to merge.

horde_large.title: Horde: swarm roar (loop)
horde_large.processing: ~150 voices + collective low roar (pitched-down lowpassed copy) - thousands from above.

zombie_death.title: Death
zombie_death.processing: Death gurgles (arcadeparty) pitch x1.3 + small splat.

zombie_reanimate.title: Reanimation
zombie_reanimate.processing: Wet slime squelch + a groan fading in - a corpse getting back up.

roof_fall.title: Roof fall + splat
roof_fall.processing: Falling whoosh + short scream-groan + wet crunch landing.

gore_splat.title: Gore splat
gore_splat.processing: Wet squish impacts (qubodup / fly swatter), tape x1.4.

steps_asphalt_walk.title: Footsteps: asphalt walk
steps_asphalt_walk.processing: Stone steps x1.75, quick tiny cadence.

squad_march.title: Many soldiers moving (loop)
squad_march.processing: ~40 soldiers' steps + gear layered: the hectic miniature patter of a big squad push.

gear_rattle.title: Gear rattle
gear_rattle.processing: Chainmail / belt / keys / buckle clicks x1.7 - webbing and kit.

vo_contact.title: Callout: contact
vo_contact.processing: "Target engaged!" / "Look out!" (Kenney voiceover, CC0) pitch x1.42, tempo x1.14.

vo_orders.title: Orders
vo_orders.processing: "Go go go!", "Cover me!", "Suppressing fire!", "Get down!", "Hold!", "Fire in the hole!".

vo_ammo.title: Asking for ammo
vo_ammo.processing: "Reloading!" / "Call for backup!" - NOTE: no CC0 recording of the word "Ammo!" found yet.

vo_panic.title: Panic
vo_panic.processing: "Please help somebody!", "Come on, let's run!", "No no no...", yells (nocturnalvanguard / arcadeparty).

vo_death.title: Death
vo_death.processing: Death cries (arcadeparty humanDeath, grunts of male death).

radio_chirp.title: Radio chirp
radio_chirp.processing: Radio squelch + static burst, band-limited 300 Hz-3 kHz.

plane_flyover.title: Plane flyover
plane_flyover.processing: Prop-plane pass tape x1.35 (toy-like RC buzz) with pan sweep, low layer -12 dB keeps it big.

chute_deploy.title: Parachute deploy
chute_deploy.processing: Fabric snap: swish + heavy cloth x1.4.

chute_flutter.title: Parachute flutter (loop)
chute_flutter.processing: Cloth rustle looped with a 9 Hz flap tremolo.

crate_thud.title: Crate landing
crate_thud.processing: Wooden crate thud x1.3 + small low layer (-8 dB).

container_land.title: Container heavy landing
container_land.processing: Steel slam x1.2 + metal debris + strong low layer (-3 dB): the one supply sound with real weight.

sledgehammer.title: Sledgehammer
sledgehammer.processing: Metal hammering hits (bart workshop / rubberduck) x1.5.

cutting_torch.title: Cutting torch (loop)
cutting_torch.processing: Gas jet x1.4 + continuous spark crackle.

gabion_done.title: Gabion wall: complete
gabion_done.processing: Final clank + settling gravel + a satisfied tap.

jerrycan_slosh.title: Jerrycan slosh
jerrycan_slosh.processing: Bottle shake recordings x1.2 - a little fuel can.

tower_creak.title: Tower creaking under attack
tower_creak.processing: Tree creak + wood squeak x1.4 - strained timber.

tower_collapse.title: Tower collapse
tower_collapse.processing: Breaking + cracking + falling timbers x1.4, low layer -6 dB.

gen_start.title: Generator start
gen_start.processing: Engine crank (car engine start) x1.4 into the generator loop.

gen_run.title: Generator run (loop)
gen_run.processing: Small petrol generator x1.35 - buzzy little engine.

gen_out_of_fuel.title: Generator out of fuel
gen_out_of_fuel.processing: Engine coughs and sputters (gated run), then dies.

floodlight_hum.title: Floodlight hum (loop)
floodlight_hum.processing: Electric buzz looped, x1.1, with a faint 50 Hz-ish body.

amb_day.title: Day city (loop)
amb_day.processing: Wind x1.2 + birds x1.4 + far tiny car alarm + distant tiny scream - a quiet street.

amb_night.title: Night (loop)
amb_night.processing: Crickets x1.3 + low wind + distant tiny howl and groan.

car_alarm.title: Miniature car alarm
car_alarm.processing: Car signal / siren x1.5 - a toy-sized alarm.

distant_scream.title: Distant tiny scream
distant_scream.processing: Screams pitched x1.42, lowpassed, roomy - far off in the city.

gas_bubble.title: Toxic bubbling (loop)
gas_bubble.processing: Gastric bubbling + bubble loop x1.3 - rot gas from corpses.

ui_tab.title: Tab click
ui_tab.processing: Kenney interface click (UI is not miniaturised).
